articles.title: nblf-queue added to PyPI
articles.summary: This repository details a Non-Blocking Lock-Free Queue (NBLFQ), an advanced data structure crucial for concurrent programming. It functions as an atomic, lock-free Multiple-Producer, Multiple-Consumer (MPMC) queue, designed to boost performance by avoiding traditional software locks. Multiple implementations with various storage and allocation strategies are provided to optimize efficiency in multi-threaded systems.

articles.title: India set to seal $230 million M777 howitzer support deal with US: Sergio Gor
articles.summary: The United States is finalizing a proposed $230 million sustainment package for India's M777A2 ultra-light howitzers. U.S. Ambassador Sergio Gor confirmed this deal, which aims to ensure the long-term operational readiness and maintenance of these critical artillery systems. This significant defence cooperation bolsters India's capabilities, particularly in challenging terrains, enhancing its strategic preparedness through continued U.S. support for these weapon systems.
